main.note: 2.11BSD uusend main (RECOVER) with the changes of WEGA: the usage with -fname, a directory as source refused (exit 6), uux without -gn -z, the default directory test appends to dnbuf, makedir and chmod 0777 apart; count initialised in its declaration.

makedir.note: odd form: the default case first in the switch, a return behind exit(1) in the child; no mode argument (main calls chmod).
